messages:
anya: quick note: onboarding zircon-embed-v2 on staging. initial recall sweep on 3k holdout shows weird pattern: int8 drop concentrated on medium-length queries (6-20 tokens) when batch_size >=256. posting numbers. :thinking_face:
liam: paste pls
anya: results:
```
model: zircon-embed-v2
dataset: holdout_3k_mixed
strata: len<=5, 6-20, >20
metric: recall@1/5
fp16 (batch 256): <=5 r@1 0.64 r@5 0.84 | 6-20 r@1 0.69 r@5 0.88 | >20 r@1 0.71 r@5 0.90
int8-per-channel (batch 256): <=5 r@1 0.61 r@5 0.80 | 6-20 r@1 0.53 r@5 0.73 | >20 r@1 0.69 r@5 0.88
int8-per-channel (batch 64): 6-20 r@1 0.62 r@5 0.82
note: batch dependent degradation for medium queries only
```
keiko: interesting. so int8+large-batch leads to recall collapse for 6-20. could be KV cache quant accumulation or micro-batching math.
oscar: did you change the inference microbatching or do continuous batching?
anya: staging runtime uses continuous batching. I re-ran inference with batch_limit=64 and recall recovered ~9 pts at @1 for 6-20.
liam: good find. can you share eval command and quant config?
anya: cmd: `python eval/recall.py --model zircon-embed-v2 --dataset holdout_3k_mixed --quant int8 --calib 2k --per_channel True --batch_limit 256 --neg 50`
quant config: per-channel int8 symmetric clamp, scale-tensor precomputed during deploy
quant-bot: quant-ci | per-channel calib samples=2048, method=symmetric, opset=pt-q8 :white_check_mark:
keiko: suspects: 1) accumulation rounding in fused matmul when many tokens/continuous batches 2) cache eviction/kludge causing norm drift 3) calibration stats not representative for medium-length sequences (we calibrated on short/long mix).
liam: can we run a quick numeric diff: fp16 vs int8 activations for a handful of medium queries with batch_varied to see where error spikes? I can run microprofiling.
oscar: Also try redoing calibration with sample set stratified by seq_len, and test asymmetric clamp.
anya: plan: liam -> activation diff + microprofile, keiko -> stratified calib (2k,8k), oscar -> run continuous-batch disabled (force no cross-request batching) as control. I'll post results here.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy | zircon-embed-v2 -> deployed to staging pool gpu-a2 (id: stg-412) :rocket:
liam: starting microprof now, will post a tiny notebook if I find a repro.
anya: thanks all 64f, tagging owners: @liam @keiko @oscar. will open ENG-1599 with initial numbers and attach UMAPs/recall table.
